title.narrative: Karnataka Integrated Urban Water Management Investment Program-Tranche 2

description.narrative: Tranche 2 will enhance urban water supply and sanitation infrastructure; and improve water resource planning, monitoring and service delivery in four coastal towns (Kundapura, Mangalore, Puttur, and Udupi). The rapid pace of economic development and urbanization of the coastal region of Karnataka has put considerable stress on the existing urban water supply and sanitation infrastructure. The groundwater table is shallow and contaminated by saltwater intrusion. The coastal towns should promote the efficient and sustainable use of water by reducing nonrevenue water, expanding water treatment capacity, improving storage facilities, and extending more connections to end-users. The sewerage system of Mangalore requires immediate rehabilitation and upgrading to enhance the capacity of the pumping main and expand coverage. To offer improved water services, urban local bodies (ULBs) must enhance their technical and financial capacity. Climate adaptation measures are required to protect this ecologically sensitive region from climate change impacts.

Output: 2. Water resource planning, monitoring, and service delivery system of urban local bodies improved Indicator: 2A. Operational capacity through policy and institutional reform actions strengthened Achievement: N Progress/Status: (i) IT Agency submitted SRS Report in Mar 2023. SRS is evaluated and accepted by KUIDFC. IT-1 Module rolled out live for Billing & Collection for Water Supply Charges for Kundapura in Jun 2023, for Harihara and Ranebennur in Jul 2023. Pilot roll out for Billing & Collection Application is completed for Puttur and Davanagere in November 2023.Payment Gateway for online payment for Harihara and Ranebennur has been implemented and for Kundapura is under staging environment. IT-2 Module: E-Sweekruthi Staging API end points shared by KMDS have been tested and found working fine. KMDS has issued a circular on SOP to be adopted in all the 8 KIUWMIP towns. IT-3 Module- Data related to Water and wastewater services MIS including NRW Management is shared with Agency. These modules are developed and being tested under Staging environment. Verification of UAT ver 2.0 submitted by Agency completed in association with Agency and Report submitted for compliance against FRS. IT-4 Module- Asset and Inventory Management modules are being tested under staging environment along with the Geo Portal. These modules are developed and being tested under Staging environment. Verification of UAT ver 2.0 submitted by Agency completed in association with Agency and Report submitted for compliance against FRS. Water Accounting, water quality monitoring, KPI Monitoring, Service Level Benchmarking and Volumetric Tariff Determination Module are finalised as per FRS and the same is being tested.
(ii)Draft Volumetric tariff model proposed for Kundapura town is submitted for adoption by the Municipal Council. Discussed with Tranche-1 and Tranche-2 stakeholders on Volumetric Tariff Determination Model in two different virtual meetings. Discussed with Byadgi stakeholders on Volumetric Tariff Determination Model in a WSC workshop.
(iii) Ring fenced accounting of water and wastewater services, enabling the ULBs to assess the income is in place. Once integration of IT Module-1 with existing IT Module -2 is completed then this will help the ULBs in complete analysis of shortfall / excess in the O&M of water supply and Sanitation expenses and Revenue generated. Mangaluru, Udupi, Puttur, Kundapura, Davanagere, Byadgi ULBs submitted report on shortfall /excess of expenses and income related to Water Supply.
(iv) Proposals for all 3 stages of sub-activities from all 4 project towns are received, appraised and approved by UIF Approval Committee. The sub-activities implementation is in progress and is being closely monitored for completion. Data Source: PPMS, KUIDFC and ULBs reports, QPRs, and PCR Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Achievement: N Progress/Status: An ADB expert mobilized to support KUIDFC and ULBs to implement policy actions. (i) Rainwater harvesting policy is in place in all four towns.
